sources.title: How to List 20+ Print-on-Demand Products in Minutes (Live Demo)
sources.teachers: Michael (host); Chris Meats (AnywherePOD founder, spelling verified in description)
sources.access: Full transcript text and description retrieved via Firecrawl YouTube postprocessor; selected substantive sections read; no audiovisual viewing.
sources.transcript_read_bounds: Read introduction/description and selected main demonstration/Q&A spanning roughly character offsets 25000–61855 of retrieved markdown; no reliable timestamps were supplied.
sources.source_summary: Research demand and keywords before scaling listings. Build one reusable product template, preserve personalized text layers, and reuse approved mockups/prices. Feed AI researched keywords and actual product information. Give distinct birthday variants their own appropriate intent rather than expecting one listing to rank for every age. Test small creative variations.
sources.application: Adapt as a manual checklist first: verified journal template, editable name, actual SKU mockups, personalized-name instructions, human-reviewed titles/tags, and a small coherent variant batch. Automation is optional.
sources.bounds: Demo uses a spiral notebook, not verified user's 200-lined-page journal. Do not transfer dimensions, materials, current prices, software availability, or gift-wrap eligibility. Speaker's tentative Etsy fee and policy statements are not authorities. Demo is commercially promotional; subscription/API costs and account permissions require independent review.
sources.retrieval_completeness: Complete transcript text returned by tool; not independently checked against audio
sources.time_anchors: Unavailable: returned transcript has no timestamps; do not invent video timecodes. Use section and character bounds recorded in transcript_read_bounds.

sources.title: What 700,000 Orders Taught Us About Winning Jewelry Phrases
sources.teachers: Michael (host; description signature; transcript surname is unreliable)
sources.access: Full transcript text and description retrieved; selected teaching and Q&A sections substantively read; no audiovisual viewing.
sources.transcript_read_bounds: Read introduction/description and main teaching/Q&A roughly character offsets 20000–68500 of 93463-character retrieved markdown; did not review every opening song or later Q&A. No reliable timestamps supplied.
sources.source_summary: Separates gift sender from recipient, studies emotional motifs, prioritizes understandable language, and recommends testing phrases with a consistent simple design before embellishing. Claimed 700,000-order analysis aggregates historical winning jewelry-card phrases. Around 70 words/five sentences are loose averages, explicitly not a formula.
sources.application: For journals, hypothesize a clear giver–recipient–occasion–feeling combination, write original short cover wording, maintain legibility beside the name, and compare controlled variants. These are coaching hypotheses until shop data supports them.
sources.bounds: Supplier retrospective claims are not independent evidence, causal proof, Etsy demand data, or journal conversion rates. Do not force jewelry word counts on journal covers, infer male buyer dominance for journals, or promise income. Do not adopt unverified assertions that fragments are public domain. Check rights and use original/licensed language.
sources.retrieval_completeness: Complete transcript text returned by tool; not independently checked against audio
sources.time_anchors: Unavailable: returned transcript has no timestamps; do not invent video timecodes. Use section and character bounds recorded in transcript_read_bounds.

sources.title: DESIGN TIPS AND TRICKS THRU PRODUCT TEARDOWN FOR PRINT-ON-DEMAND | Coffee with Michael | ShineOn
sources.teachers: Michael and Jim named in transcript; additional speaker's name is inconsistently transcribed, not asserted.
sources.access: Full transcript retrieved; selected first product teardown read; historical corroboration only; no audiovisual viewing.
sources.transcript_read_bounds: Introduction/description and approximately character offsets 25500–42500 of 89190-character markdown. No reliable timestamps supplied.
sources.source_summary: First teardown discusses readable message placement, reducing distracting details, and distinguishing feed-ad requirements from Etsy product-page presentation. Panelists disagree on how to show a necklace/earring bundle. One favors larger order value; another favors a simpler acquisition image.
sources.application: Use legibility and honest product hierarchy as review prompts. For journals, consider bundles only after verifying components, fulfillment, margin, and genuine customer need.
sources.bounds: Jewelry example and 2022 tactics are not current Etsy rules. Do not fabricate free gifts, inflated reference prices, customer-style testimonials, or undisclosed UGC. No present bundle availability verified.

sources.title: 10 Etsy Ranking Tips Most POD Sellers Completely Ignore
sources.access: Full description and entire 18884-character transcript read; no audiovisual viewing.
sources.transcript_read_bounds: All retrieved transcript text; no reliable timestamps supplied.
sources.source_summary: Recommends relevant researched keywords, separating buyer intent from recipient, coherent store branding, and a clear, readable main product image. Suggests occasional promotions and product diversity, but supports several ranking claims with anecdote or speculation.
